While it may seem like 2026 went by in a blur, it’s already time for the holidays.

And Kylie Kelce is making the most of the season with her “Not Gonna Lie” podcast’s inaugural gift guide, featuring picks like the BareMinerals Original Loose Powder Foundation she’s been wearing for decades.

“I’ve talked about it so many times at this point, I love it,” she said, while brushing some on during a segment about Ulta Beauty.

“Blur your s—t,” she quipped. “It is just the right amount of blur; my skin still feels like skin. It doesn’t feel like I have a whole layer of foundation caked on my face.”

She also said that she loves how the formula helps mattify, as she’s “not a dewy girl.”

Made from five vegan ingredients, the powder is designed to help blur fine lines and visible pores, while remaining breathable enough for all-day coverage.

It’s hardly the first time she’s name-dropped the formula, as she said on her podcast earlier this year that she’d been using BareMinerals since high school. (“It’s buildable and goes on like a nice, blurred filter, but you can still see my freckles,” she added at the time.)

She’s not alone in her love for it, as it’s earned a nearly perfect 4.7-star average out of over 25,000 (!) Amazon reviews.

“What I like the most is how lightweight it feels,” one satisfied shopper wrote. “It doesn’t feel heavy or cakey at all, even after a few hours of wear.”

The best part? With Amazon’s Black Friday sale already in full swing, it’s the prime time to score some for over 30% off.

While Black Friday may feel like its own season, the official sale date is Friday, November 27.

Early deals run throughout November, with many discounts just as good as the main event. Track our best deals and make a plan so you don’t miss out on the goods you really want.

The biggest online shopping holiday of the year is on Monday, November 30, 2026.

TLDR: it depends. Black Friday sales may carry higher inventory of popular items that may sell out, like UGGs and the Dyson Airwrap. However, Cyber Monday sales sometimes offer deeper discounts, depending on the retailer.

Of course! Black Friday and Cyber Monday still offer some of the biggest sales of the year on must-have tech like AirPods, designer clothing, shoes and accessories, beauty buys and top-rated gifts.

Right here, at Page Six! If you’re in the market for celebrity-worthy styles on a budget, luxury beauty and skincare for less, or gifts so good you’ll want to keep them for yourself, check out our expert-curated Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals for the best of the best.

This article was written by Hannah Southwick, Commerce Associate Editor for Page Six. Hannah spies deals on actually affordable celebrity-worn styles, puts celebrities’ brands to the test and finds the beauty products that keep stars red carpet-ready. She consults stylists and industry pros — including celebs themselves — for firsthand product recommendations, trend predictions and more. In addition to writing for Page Six since 2020, her work has been featured in USA Today and Parade.

پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. اگرچه ممکن است به نظر برسد که سال 2026 در هاله ای از ابهام سپری شده است، اما اکنون زمان تعطیلات فرا رسیده است. و کایلی کلس با راهنمای هدیه افتتاحیه پادکست خود "Not Gonna Lie" بهترین استفاده را از فصل می برد، که شامل انتخاب هایی مانند BareMinerals Original Loose Powder است. او در حالی که در بخشی از بخش زیبایی Ulta Beauty صحبت می‌کرد، گفت: «در این مرحله بارها در مورد آن صحبت کرده‌ام، دوستش دارم. "این فقط مقدار مناسبی از تاری است؛ پوست من هنوز مانند پوست است. این احساس نمی‌شود که یک لایه کامل از فونداسیون روی صورتم چسبیده باشد."
او همچنین گفت که عاشق این است که چگونه این فرمول به مات شدن کمک می کند، زیرا او "دختری شبنم دار نیست". این پودر که از پنج ماده گیاهی ساخته شده است برای کمک به محو کردن خطوط ریز و منافذ قابل مشاهده طراحی شده است، در حالی که به اندازه کافی تنفس می کند تا پوشش کل روز را پوشش دهد. این اولین باری نیست که او از این فرمول استفاده می کند، زیرا او در پادکست خود در اوایل امسال گفت که از دوران دبیرستان از BareMinerals استفاده می کرده است. (او در آن زمان اضافه کرد: «قابل ساخت است و مانند یک فیلتر خوب و تار ادامه می‌یابد، اما همچنان می‌توانید کک و مک‌های من را ببینید.» او در عشقش به آن تنها نیست، زیرا میانگین تقریباً عالی 4.7 ستاره از بیش از 25000 (!) بررسی آمازون را به دست آورده است. یکی از خریداران راضی نوشت: "چیزی که من بیشتر از همه دوست دارم این است که چقدر سبک وزن است." حتی پس از چند ساعت استفاده، اصلاً احساس سنگینی یا بدی به نظر نمی‌رسد.

John Travolta admits he didn’t have much fun playing real-life mobster John “Handsome Johnny” Roselli in “November 1963.”

“It’s fun pulling it off, but becoming those guys is not fun,” the actor, 72, told Page Six at a special screening of the movie earlier this week. “It’s a very dark state of mind, so…I can’t lie to you, it’s too dark a material to say it was fun.”

The “Pulp Fiction” star added that he is “pleased with the result of being believable in it, and doing my job as an actor.”

Roselli was a mobster associated with the Chicago Outfit, who helped the crime organization gain influence over Hollywood and Las Vegas. He was also recruited by the CIA in plots to assassinate Cuban leader Fidel Castro.

In 1976, his strangled body was discovered in an oil drum. His murder has never been solved.

It’s not the first time the actor has played an underworld figure; in 2018, he played infamous crime boss John Gotti in “Gotti.”

“November 1963” concerns the assassination of President John F. Kennedy and explores the theory that Chicago mobsters orchestrated the late president’s murder over alleged broken political promises. It also stars Robert Carlyle, Dermot Mulroney, Jefferson White and Mandy Patinkin.

Lee Harvey Oswald was charged with the assassination, but denied responsibility, claiming he was a fall guy. Two days later, Oswald was murdered by a nightclub owner, Jack Ruby, on live television. White and Carlyle play Oswald and Ruby, respectively, in the film.

The “Saturday Night Fever” star said he believes the movie’s premise because of “government documents.”

“There’s a truth here that seems to make sense,” he added. “The puzzle seems to fit, it’s very specific. You can’t make this up, right? You know what I mean.”

“That’s why I kind of think it’s true, right?” he concluded.

Travolta attended the screening without his usual plus one, his daughter Ella, and without his jaunty beret.

بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. جان تراولتا اعتراف می‌کند که از بازی در نقش یک مافور واقعی جانی «جانی خوش‌تیپ» روزلی در «نوامبر 1963» لذت چندانی نداشته است.
این بازیگر 72 ساله در یک اکران ویژه این فیلم در اوایل این هفته به صفحه شش گفت: «درآوردن آن سرگرم کننده است، اما تبدیل شدن به آن پسرها سرگرم کننده نیست. "این یک حالت ذهنی بسیار تاریک است، بنابراین ... نمی توانم به شما دروغ بگویم، این یک ماده بسیار تاریک است که نمی توان گفت سرگرم کننده است." ستاره «پالپ فیکشن» افزود که «از نتیجه باورپذیر بودن در آن و انجام وظیفه‌ام به‌عنوان بازیگر راضی است».
رزلی یک اوباش مرتبط با شیکاگو Outfit بود که به سازمان جنایی کمک کرد تا بر هالیوود و لاس وگاس نفوذ کند. او همچنین توسط سیا در توطئه های ترور فیدل کاسترو رهبر کوبا استخدام شد. در سال 1976، جسد خفه شده او در یک بشکه نفت کشف شد. قتل او هرگز حل نشد. این اولین بار نیست که این بازیگر نقش یک شخصیت دنیای اموات را بازی می کند. در سال 2018، او نقش رئیس جنایی بدنام جان گوتی را در «گوتی» بازی کرد.
روز خود را با Page Six Daily شروع کنید. لطفاً یک ایمیل معتبر ارائه دهید. با کلیک کردن بر روی بالا، با شرایط استفاده و خط مشی رازداری موافقت می کنید. آیا می خواهید اخبار مربوط به افراد مشهور به محض انتشار برسد؟ "نوامبر 1963" مربوط به ترور رئیس جمهور جان اف. کندی و این نظریه را بررسی می‌کند که اوباش شیکاگو قتل رئیس‌جمهور فقید را بر اساس وعده‌های سیاسی ناقص سازماندهی کردند. در این فیلم رابرت کارلایل، درموت مولرونی، جفرسون وایت و مندی پتینکین نیز ایفای نقش می‌کنند. لی هاروی اسوالد متهم به این قتل شد.

More than 51,000 units of toothpaste and mouthwash made for children and adults have been recalled nationwide after federal testing detected hormones in product samples, according to the Food and Drug Administration.Scottsdale, Arizona-based ORL Labs LLC initiated the voluntary recall of 51,762 units of six ORL Organic Oral Care products after the FDA notified the company that testing found progesterone, estradiol or dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA) in samples, according to an FDA enforcement report.

Progesterone and estradiol are primary female sex hormones, while DHEA is a hormone the body uses to produce estrogen and testosterone.

The recall began Oct. 12 and was classified by the agency as Class II on Nov. 6.

A Class II designation applies when exposure to a violative product may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences or where the probability of serious adverse health consequences is remote, according to the FDA.

The FDA report did not specify which hormones or what concentrations were detected in individual samples, nor did it explain how the cross-contamination occurred.

Affected products were distributed nationwide and carry expiration dates between September 2026 and August 2028.

The recall applies to 4-ounce tubes of ORL Organic Oral Care natural toothpaste in Fresh Mint (19,247 units, UPC 850006245499), Cinnamint (7,202 units, UPC 850006245512) and Bubblegum Kids (3,976 units, UPC 850006245505).

It also covers 16.9-ounce bottles of ORL mouthwash in Fresh Mint (12,081 units, UPC 850006245451), Cinnamint Kids (6,140 units, UPC 850006245468) and Bubblegum Kids (3,116 units, UPC 850006245475).

Specific lot numbers for each affected product are listed in the FDA enforcement report.

ORL Labs did not issue a press release for the recall and notified consignees or the public by letter, according to the FDA filing.

The agency report did not include specific disposal or refund instructions for consumers.

A representative for ORL Labs did not immediately respond to FOX Business’ request for comment.

Consumers with questions can contact the company at 844-675-5227 or orl@orlcares.com.

ORL Labs LLC مستقر در اسکاتسدیل، آریزونا، فراخوان داوطلبانه 51762 واحد از 6 محصول مراقبت از دهان ارگانیک ORL را پس از اینکه FDA به شرکت اطلاع داد که آزمایش پروژسترون، استرادیول یا دهیدرواپی آندروسترون (DHEA) را در نمونه‌ها پیدا کرد، آغاز کرد. در حالی که DHEA هورمونی است که بدن برای تولید استروژن و تستوسترون از آن استفاده می کند. فراخوان در اکتبر آغاز شد. 12 و در 6 نوامبر توسط آژانس به عنوان کلاس II طبقه بندی شد. طبق FDA، تعیین کلاس II زمانی اعمال می شود که قرار گرفتن در معرض یک محصول متخلف ممکن است پیامدهای نامطلوب سلامتی موقت یا قابل برگشت پزشکی ایجاد کند یا در مواردی که احتمال عواقب نامطلوب جدی برای سلامتی دور باشد. گزارش FDA مشخص نکرده است که کدام هورمون یا چه غلظتی در نمونه‌های جداگانه شناسایی شده است، و همچنین توضیحی در مورد چگونگی وقوع آلودگی متقاطع ارائه نکرده است. محصولات آسیب‌دیده در سراسر کشور توزیع شده‌اند و دارای تاریخ انقضا بین سپتامبر 2026 و اوت 2028 هستند. این فراخوان برای تیوب‌های 4 اونسی خمیر دندان طبیعی ORL Organic Oral Care در Fresh Mint (19247 واحد، UPC 850006245499)، Cinnamint (7202 واحد، UPC 850006245512 UPC 850006245512) و 850006245512، 30 و 50 گرم (30، 50 گرم) و Bubblem اعمال می‌شود.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

No “Blexas” here: at least on one map, Texas is as red as ever.

The Lone Star State has entered “very high” rates of disease on the CDC’s infectious disease tracker, one of only two states on this highest alert.

It’s a worrying sign as the winter season — and all its contagious bugs — picks up.

Texas is one of the worst states hit by flu-like illnesses this season, second only to Louisiana, according to data from the CDC. The New York / New Jersey area hasn’t escaped rising cases, either.

It’s the worst seen this season so far, but it’ll likely get worse through the beginning of 2027.

The CDC’s map tracks influenza-like illness (ILI) visits to the doctor for symptoms that include fever and cough or sore throat. That means the cases aren’t confirmed by a lab to be the flu, and it could include other illnesses with similar symptoms, like COVID-19 and RSV.

In Texas, there have been increases in emergency department visits for COVID-19, flu and RSV, as well as hospitalizations for the same diseases in the last week. The latest confirmed numbers of flu are from last week (Nov. 8 to 14), with 1,221 confirmed flu cases over that period.

Louisiana’s latest available figures (from Nov. 1–7) show that nearly 17% of flu tests came back positive, with infections on the rise. The report also shows that 7.2% of emergency department visits were for flu-like illness, up from previous weeks.

According to the CDC’s map, the next hardest hit states are Oregon, Tennessee, and South Carolina, followed by California, Colorado, New Mexico and Georgia. All these states are considered to have “high” ILI activity levels.

New York and New Jersey are both considered to have “moderate” levels with New Jersey having slightly less activity.

In New York, cases of the flu last week are actually slightly down (4%) from the previous week. The latest numbers are 11,891 cases of the flu from the week ending Nov. 14, with over 43,000 total flu cases this season. That said, flu hospitalizations are slightly up, by 2%.

In New Jersey, flu cases and ER visits decreased this week (ending Nov. 19) compared to last, but officials say numbers are still higher than levels observed during the same time last year.

State and federal health agencies track the flu year round on a 52 (sometimes 53) week cycle — flu spreads all year round. Normally, flu cases start to pick up in October with a peak in December to February of the new year.

Except this year, the flu season started early — at the end of summer. This has resulted in higher cases throughout the fall compared to typically-seen numbers, and is expected to continue to rise through early next year.

According to a report from Epic Research, flu positivity was 1.5% by mid-September, the highest value from that time in six years. In 2022, the positivity was just 0.8% and in 2023, 0.9%.

By the end of October, the CDC said more than 1.7 million people had the flu and 1,400 people died from the illness.

It’s a worrying trend, but it’s still too early to tell if this will be a particularly bad flu season based on early numbers.

To protect yourself from the flu, get vaccinated. There are many options for flu shots, including a new mRNA vaccine approved for those 50 and up.

During flu season, you’ll also want to continue practicing good habits: cover your mouth when you cough or sneeze, wash your hands, avoid touching your eyes, nose or mouth, and clean regularly touched surfaces. It can help to use an air purifier as well.

Remember to avoid close contact with people who are sick and stay home when you get sick to avoid spreading illness.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

Former Marlins president and current Meadowlark sports personality David Samson believes ESPN needs to move on from Troy Aikman now amid his uncomfortable tension with Joe Buck in his contract standoff to prevent a potential disaster when ESPN hosts its first Super Bowl in February.

“Apparently Troy Aikman has gotten to the ‘I don’t give an eff stage’ of his career with ESPN because he keeps doing these things. And here’s the problem — Jimmy Pitaro has to end this,” Samson said Friday on his “Nothing Personal with David Samson” podcast. “I don’t know whether he ends it today, tomorrow, next week or next month, but ESPN cannot have Joe Buck and Troy Aikman call the Super Bowl. They have invested too much money to have any distraction that they know about entering into the leadup to the Super Bowl.

“There’s always going to be something that happens. But if I am Jimmy Pitaro, I am making sure that I find someone to call the Super Bowl right now and that I start the process. So that the audience, that the media, that the gossipers, that we get it all out of our system. We deal with the fact that Aikman is gone from ‘Monday Night Football,’ and we deal with it now. By the time the playoffs and the Super Bowl comes, it’s no longer part of the conversation.”

This ESPN drama centers on how Buck is safe with the network after receiving a six-year, $108 million extension, while Aikman is playing out his contract without a new deal.

Buck and Aikman had an on-field riff before a Bills-Rams “Monday Night Football” game in October that has led to Aikman speaking publicly about his uncertain future.

The former Cowboys quarterback appeared to turn up the intensity by saying on a radio appearance earlier this week: “Well, I know Joe’s always wanted a one-man booth…”

The situation has gotten so awkward that ESPN chair Jimmy Pitaro had to address it.

“Are we happy about the media coverage recently? Of course not,” Pitaro said Tuesday. “It’s been disappointing, but these guys are professionals, and they’re delivering every week. If you watched it (Monday) night, last night was another super high-quality production and telecast. I fully expect that to continue through the season and through the Super Bowl.”

Samson said ESPN boss Jimmy Pitaro has “two children who don’t like each other” and added that viewers don’t like watching two partners who did not get along.

He said Pitaro should at least reach out to Aikman about being professional through the end of the season, which concludes with ESPN hosting Super Bowl 2027.

There are no indications yet that Aikman’s role for the Big Game is in jeopardy, although some have wondered — like Samson — if that could change if this feud continues to fester.

“Because if Jimmy Pitaro does not make a move, and it’s Troy Aikman calling the Super Bowl with Joe Buck,” Samson continued, “what do you think is the first thing that’s going to get talked about? ‘Wow, it looks like in the second quarter there right before the commercial that they looked at each other like a bunch of hated men.’ No, nobody wants that, certainly not ESPN or Disney.

“Wait to see … Troy Aikman will not call the Super Bowl.”
news.content:
بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. دیوید سامسون، رئیس سابق مارلینز و شخصیت فعلی ورزش Meadowlark معتقد است که ESPN باید اکنون در میان تنش ناراحت کننده اش با جو باک در بن بست قراردادش، از تروی آیکمن خارج شود تا از یک فاجعه احتمالی که ESPN میزبان اولین Super Bowl خود در فوریه است، جلوگیری کند. سامسون روز جمعه در پادکست خود با عنوان «Nothing Personal with David Samson» گفت: «ظاهراً تروی آیکمن به «مرحله‌ی اثربخشی» حرفه‌اش با ESPN رسیده است، زیرا به این کارها ادامه می‌دهد. و مشکل اینجاست - جیمی پیتارو باید به این موضوع پایان دهد. من نمی‌دانم که او امروز، فردا، هفته آینده یا ماه آینده به پایان می‌رساند، اما ESPN نمی‌تواند جو باک و تروی آیکمن را وادار کند که Super Bowl را صدا کنند. آن‌ها آنقدر پول سرمایه‌گذاری کرده‌اند که حواس‌شان را پرت می‌کنند که می‌دانند وارد مسابقات سوپر باول شوند. «همیشه اتفاقی می‌افتد. اما اگر من جیمی پیتارو هستم، مطمئن می‌شوم که کسی را پیدا می‌کنم که همین الان سوپربول را صدا بزنم و این فرآیند را شروع کنم. به طوری که مخاطبان، رسانه‌ها، که شایعه‌پردازان از سیستم ما خارج شوند، همه آن را از سیستم ما خارج کنند. ما با این واقعیت کنار می‌آییم که آیکمن از «فوتبال دوشنبه‌شب» رفته است و اکنون به آن می‌پردازیم. زمانی که بازی های پلی آف و سوپر باول فرا می رسد، دیگر بخشی از گفتگو نیست."
این درام ESPN به این موضوع می‌پردازد که چگونه باک پس از دریافت تمدید 6 ساله 108 میلیون دلاری با شبکه ایمن است، در حالی که آیکمن در حال اجرای قرارداد خود بدون قرارداد جدید است.

news.originalContent:
Rodrigo Muniz set Fulham on the way but Elliot Anderson volley earns Manchester City a valuable Premier League point.

Manchester City avoided the ignominy of a fourth-straight defeat as Elliot Anderson’s strike kept an unsettled Etihad Stadium at bay in a 1-1 draw with Fulham in the Premier League.

Rodrigo Muniz opened the scoring in the 16th minute for the away side, who had only won two of their opening 10 league games to start the day just two points and three places above the relegation zone.

Anderson’s driven volley from the edge of the box in the 57th minute handed City their first point in the league since they opened their campaign with seven consecutive wins.

The midfielder, who had netted his first City goal since arriving from Nottingham Forest, nearly added a second with a burst into the box, but dragged his effort across the face.

City, who sit five points off top spot, had lost to Brighton, RB Leipzig and Forest in their previous games.

Holders and league leaders Arsenal play their game in hand over City at Newcastle later on Saturday.

City held one of the longest winning streaks in English football history with 20 straight victories over Fulham dating back to 2012.

That run is now over, but City’s run of poor results is not.

Boos from the home support greeted the final whistle, with City’s winless run in the league extending to four games — a stretch that has come soon after the club was found guilty of large-scale financial rule-breaking that leaves its future shrouded in uncertainty.

The display was far from convincing for City, with Erling Haaland guilty of wasting two great chances in the first half — and having one goal ruled out in contentious circumstances.

After having a close-range effort saved by Bernd Leno, Haaland followed up and bundled the ball out of the Fulham goalkeeper’s possession and into the net on the goal line.

It was judged that Haaland kicked the ball out of Leno’s hands, with the Premier League saying Leno was deemed to be “in control of the ball”.

news.originalContent:
Photo by David McNew/Getty Images

A federal jury has convicted a man of igniting the fire that grew into the catastrophic Palisades Fire.

Jonathan Rinderknecht was found guilty Friday on two federal arson counts following a retrial in Los Angeles, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Central District of California. Jurors convicted him of destroying property by fire and committing arson against property tied to interstate commerce.

Rinderknecht lit the Lachman Fire shortly after midnight on Jan. 1, 2025, near the Pacific Palisades on land belonging to the Mountains Recreation and Conservation Authority. Investigators classified it as a holdover fire, one that burned underground before resurfacing on Jan. 7 under heavy winds and erupting into the Palisades Fire.

Former L.A. resident found guilty of federal charges for deliberately starting what became the Palisades Fire last year https://t.co/wScUYvA4KL

The blaze tore through Pacific Palisades, scorched more than 23,000 acres across three weeks, and left 12 people dead, KABC reported.

Before anyone had been charged, prominent voices on the left tied the January 2025 fires to climate change. Democratic California Rep. Dave Min, independent Vermont Sen. Bernie Sanders, Democratic Texas Rep. Jasmine Crockett, and Democratic Washington Gov. Jay Inslee each pointed to a warming climate as the fires burned, Fox News reported.

“Climate change is real, not ‘a hoax,’” Sanders wrote in a social media post, saying President Donald Trump should treat the fires as an existential crisis.

The conviction arrived only after a first trial collapsed. That jury deadlocked 10-2 in favor of acquittal before U.S. District Judge Anne Hwang declared a mistrial, NBC Los Angeles reported, and prosecutors chose to retry the case on two counts rather than the original three. (RELATED: Judge Rules Mistrial In Deadly Palisades Fire Case)

Federal prosecutors credited the forensic work behind the win. “Jonathan Rinderknecht deliberately ignited a fire that killed 12 people and devastated an entire community,” First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli stated. “We were determined to hold him accountable.”

GUILTY. A federal jury has convicted Jonathan Rinderknecht, 30, on both counts of deliberately starting the fire that became the Palisades Fire. Twelve people were killed. More than 6,800 structures were destroyed. An estimated $25 billion in damage resulted. My office remained committed to securing this conviction after the first mistrial. Today’s verdict delivers a measure of justice for the victims of this horrific tragedy.

For some survivors, the outcome brought little peace. “There is a part of me that it feels very heavy that perhaps some people are laying full blame on him when there were many institutional and system failures that contributed,” Pacific Palisades resident Jackie Adams said, according to KABC.

Rinderknecht faces a minimum of five years and as long as 40 years in federal prison, with sentencing set for March 17, 2027.

Photo by Win McNamee/Getty Images

President Donald Trump wants to punish American firms that move their artificial intelligence muscle beyond the nation’s borders.

The president said Friday that the United States would hit companies building data centers overseas with financial penalties, a step he tied to keeping the domestic AI industry ahead of China, according to Reuters. He pledged a “tremendous tax” on firms that locate the facilities abroad, speaking at a White House news conference after returning from a trip through Asia. “We’re not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country,” Trump stated.

Trump: "We’re not allowing data centers to go into other countries. Because China will take all of them. We’re not gonna allow that to happen. They want to build one in Finland. We’re not allowing that to happen." https://t.co/L7wptF1ki7

Data centers supply the raw computing power that trains and operates advanced AI systems, so any penalty on foreign construction could tangle the worldwide buildout, Reuters reported. Equinix and Digital Realty rank among the US developers that already run such sites in other countries. Companies frequently plant the facilities near their users because distance slows time-sensitive work like payment processing, and shipping huge volumes of data across long stretches drives up expenses. (RELATED: Minneapolis Narrowly Votes To Make Big Data Centers Buy Green Power)

That overseas logic now collides with a separate squeeze at home. Analysts warned that Trump’s reciprocal tariffs could hobble Big Tech’s push to build AI infrastructure inside the country, StreetInsider reported through Reuters. Bernstein placed data-processing machine imports at roughly $200 billion in 2024, drawn mostly from Mexico, Taiwan, China and Vietnam.

The threat landed days after a fresh move against Beijing. The Commerce Department issued a rule Nov. 16 restricting advanced chip shipments to Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil, countries where Chinese firms have tapped foreign data centers to reach hardware they cannot buy directly, the Korea JoongAng Daily reported. Trump left for the Philippines and China the same week and planned to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen.

The president has long championed domestic data-center construction, a stance that sits poorly with many voters, Reuters reported. The race to erect the facilities has stalled against resident frustration, according to Fortune. New York imposed a moratorium on hyperscale sites and Texas froze new development, Bloomberg Law reported.

Trump has said China welcomes what he called the “anti-Data Center movement,” arguing opposition would steer business toward its chief rival, Al Jazeera stated.

به گزارش رویترز، مراکز داده نیروی محاسباتی خامی را که سیستم‌های هوش مصنوعی پیشرفته را آموزش می‌دهند و راه‌اندازی می‌کنند، تامین می‌کنند، بنابراین هرگونه جریمه در ساخت‌وساز خارجی می‌تواند ساختار جهانی را درهم ببندد. Equinix و Digital Realty در میان توسعه دهندگان آمریکایی قرار دارند که قبلاً چنین سایت هایی را در کشورهای دیگر راه اندازی می کنند. شرکت‌ها اغلب تسهیلات را در نزدیکی کاربران خود نصب می‌کنند، زیرا مسافت کار حساس به زمان مانند پردازش پرداخت را کند می‌کند و ارسال حجم عظیمی از داده‌ها در طولانی مدت باعث افزایش هزینه‌ها می‌شود. news.originalContent:
Iran’s FM Araghchi says there is ‘major strategic debate’ about the future of Iran’s nuclear doctrine.

Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said the country’s stockpile of enriched uranium will be used according to its needs, “however they are defined”, as he spoke about possible changes to Iran’s longstanding nuclear doctrine.

Araghchi’s comments during an interview with Iranian media on Saturday have increased speculation that Iran may be moving away from its policy of limiting its nuclear programme to civilian purposes amid its conflict with the United States.

The future of Iran’s nuclear programme has become a major sticking point in efforts to end the war, with Washington insisting that it must have guarantees that Iran will never develop a nuclear weapon before it will agree to a full ceasefire.

So, is Iran’s nuclear policy changing, and what could that mean for the conflict?

Iran has consistently maintained that its nuclear programme is for peaceful purposes only, such as for electricity generation, medical research and agriculture.

This policy has been underlined by a decades-old religious decree, or fatwa, issued by the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, banning the development of nuclear weapons.

However, Iran has also insisted it has the right to enrich uranium for these purposes under the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), which it joined in 1970. It has called this right “non-negotiable”.

In an interview with Iran’s state-run IRNA news agency on Saturday, Araghchi reiterated that Iran’s stockpile of enriched material would remain inside the country.

The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) estimated in 2025 – before Israel launched strikes on Iran in June that year – that Iran had about 440 kilogrammes (970 pounds) of uranium enriched to about 60 percent. This is short of the 90 percent required for making nuclear weapons, but is the level at which it becomes much quicker to reach 90 percent. It is also far beyond the roughly 3 percent needed for power generation.

This material, Araghchi said during his interview, would “be used according to our needs however those needs are defined”.

Araghchi also made reference to an ongoing debate among lawmakers and officials in Iran about altering its nuclear doctrine, and said people on both sides of that debate have “strong arguments”.

“This is a major strategic debate, and there is nothing wrong with examining it seriously because it directly concerns national interests and security,” Araghchi said, adding that those in favour of reform argue Iran’s current approach of no nuclear weapons has “failed to protect” the country’s nuclear facilities, which have come under attack from US and Israeli forces both last year and this year.

However, Araghchi acknowledged that any official change to the policy would have “far-reaching consequences”.

“For now, our doctrine has not changed, and our official position remains the same,” he said.

Other Iranian officials have also spoken about a potential review of the country’s nuclear doctrine. Earlier this month, security chief Mohsen Rezaei said “there is a discussion on whether we want to continue to follow the previous nuclear doctrine in the event of a new war breaking out”, though he also stressed that Tehran has not yet made any change.

On November 12, Iran’s Assembly of Experts, the body that appoints the supreme leader, said reviewing “the country’s defence doctrine and establishing the necessary deterrence have become unavoidable necessities”.

Ali Fathollah-Nejad, a German-Iranian political scientist who directs the Center for Middle East and Global Order (CMEG), told Al Jazeera the move by the Assembly of Experts “appears to mark the first time a governing institution has endorsed this position”.

Besides being a signatory to the NPT in 1970, Iran also initially complied with a nuclear agreement it struck with the US and other global powers in 2015 – the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), which required it to limit uranium enrichment to very low levels and undergo inspections.

But after Washington pulled out of the deal in 2018 under the first administration of US President Donald Trump, Tehran eventually went back to intensifying its nuclear programme and abandoned restrictions imposed by the deal.

In June 2025, the IAEA’s board of governors declared Iran was no longer complying with its commitment to international nuclear safeguards. Tehran rejected that report and accused the IAEA of giving a pretext for US and Israeli attacks targeting Iranian nuclear facilities, including Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan, just days later during the 12-day war.

In March of this year, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said at least 200kg (440lbs) of Iran’s enriched material was believed to have survived the US-Israeli attacks and was likely buried underground in or near the Isfahan nuclear facility site.

Grossi has since said the agency cannot verify the amount or location of Iran’s enriched material due to a lack of access.

The IAEA has called Iran’s enrichment level “a matter of serious concern”, while the US has pointed to it as evidence that Iran is pursuing nuclear weapons despite its official policy.

“If you don’t want a nuclear weapon, then why do you need 60 percent enriched fuel?” US Vice President JD Vance said in an interview with the Reuters news agency last month. “And if you want to show commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, don’t build highly enriched fuel. That’s a very basic threshold issue.”

President Trump has repeatedly stated that Iran must never be allowed to develop a nuclear weapon.

Officials in Israel, which is widely believed to have its own undeclared nuclear weapons, have also long accused Iran of pursuing nuclear weapons.

“The Iranian regime, which seeks to destroy Israel, is once again working to revive its nuclear programme,” said Israel’s now-caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in an address last week. “We must remove this existential threat once and for all.”

That remains to be seen, but it is “within the realm of possibility”, Rouzbeh Parsi, an Iran analyst and affiliated researcher at Lund University’s Department of History and Human Rights Studies, told Al Jazeera.

He said the US-Israeli war launched against Iran in February this year “has significantly changed all the calculations in Tehran”, with more open discussion about whether to renew the late ayatollah’s ban on nuclear weapons now taking place.

“What used to be a fringe opinion, leaving the NPT and potentially going for a nuclear weapon, is now something that’s within the realm of possibility – even though all the major players are still warning against it,” said Parsi. “It’s not a decision but an indication that deterrence is being rethought in light of the war.”

Simon Mabon, a professor of international politics at Lancaster University, told Al Jazeera that a “broadly rational defensive reason” for potentially shifting Iran’s nuclear policy is emerging within the country, though adding that such a shift would be legally and ethically problematic.

“If you look at the sort of traditional nuclear logic, it says that nuclear weapons play a very strong defensive role in deterring the actions of another state,” Mabon told Al Jazeera. “That would be very sound logic for the Iranians in light of what’s happened.”

“This, of course, is something that’s deeply problematic,” said Mabon. “It goes against the terms of the NPT, it goes against the spirit of the NPT, so it would necessitate withdrawal from that.”

CMEG director Fathollah-Nejad said that there are serious divisions within Iran’s government over the direction of its nuclear programme.

Hardline lawmakers and religious leaders view Iran’s nuclear and missile assets as “indispensable” to “regime security and deterrence”, while a separate camp that includes former Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif argues against the development of nuclear arms, saying it would “almost inevitably” trigger further attacks by the US and Israel, said Fathollah-Nejad.

For now, he added, Iran “plays with the ambiguity” of its nuclear policy.

Fathollah-Nejad said a shift in Iran’s nuclear doctrine would directly counter the US’s “single most important goal” in the conflict: to secure nuclear concessions from Tehran.

The US has insisted Iran must make nuclear commitments at the outset of any negotiations, while Iran wants its own seven stated conditions met, including lifting the blockade, restoring access to its frozen assets and ending hostilities on all fronts, before even beginning discussions about its nuclear programme.

Mabon said a change in Iran’s nuclear policy “would have a dramatic impact on how the Americans and the Israelis read the next phase of this conflict”, with the Israelis likely believing it necessitates a “return to violence”.

“That’s where some of the other dangers start to come in,” Mabon added. “The shift in Iran’s doctrine, even if it’s meant intentionally as a defensive shift, can easily be read in offensive terms.”

“I think it’s a very, very dangerous moment,” he said.
news.content: عراقچی، وزیر امور خارجه ایران، گفت: «بحث استراتژیک بزرگی» درباره آینده دکترین هسته‌ای ایران وجود دارد. عباس عراقچی، وزیر امور خارجه ایران گفته است که از ذخایر اورانیوم غنی‌شده ایران براساس نیازهای آن استفاده می‌شود، «هرچند که تعریف شود» او درباره تغییرات احتمالی در دکترین قدیمی هسته‌ای ایران صحبت کرد. اظهارات عراقچی در مصاحبه روز شنبه با رسانه های ایرانی این گمانه زنی را افزایش داد که ایران ممکن است در بحبوحه درگیری با ایالات متحده از سیاست محدود کردن برنامه هسته ای خود به اهداف غیرنظامی دور شود. آینده برنامه هسته‌ای ایران به نقطه‌ی بن‌بست در تلاش‌ها برای پایان دادن به جنگ تبدیل شده است، با اصرار واشنگتن بر این که باید تضمین‌هایی داشته باشد که ایران هرگز سلاح هسته‌ای تولید نخواهد کرد قبل از اینکه با آتش‌بس کامل موافقت کند. ایران پیوسته تاکید کرده است که برنامه هسته‌ای‌اش فقط برای مقاصد صلح‌آمیز است، مانند تولید برق، تحقیقات پزشکی و کشاورزی. این سیاست توسط یک فرمان مذهبی یا فتوای چند دهه‌ای که توسط مرحوم آیت‌الله علی خامنه‌ای صادر شد، مبنی بر ممنوعیت توسعه سلاح‌های هسته‌ای تاکید شده است. با این حال، ایران همچنین تاکید کرده است که بر اساس معاهده منع گسترش سلاح‌های هسته‌ای (NPT) که در سال 1970 به آن پیوست، حق غنی‌سازی اورانیوم را برای این اهداف دارد. این حق را «غیرقابل مذاکره» نامیده است.

news.originalContent:
Photo by Karl Mondon / AFP via Getty Images

Americans want to hit pause on artificial intelligence (AI) and AI chip sales to China, according to a poll exclusively obtained by the Daily Caller News Foundation.

A survey commissioned by the Demand Progress Education Fund found many Americans voted during the midterms elections based on their skepticism of AI, data centers and big tech companies. Now, they want to rein in AI, believing that some companies have too much power, which may put the country at risk.

“This new polling proves that AI isn’t a partisan issue. No one wants companies putting corporate profits above safety and no one trusts them to investigate their own crimes. Congress needs to investigate Nvidia for their role in chip smuggling and determine if our National Security was harmed,” Colin McGlynn, an AI advisor for Demand Progress, told the DCNF in a statement.

Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in mid-November admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy and founder of Megaspeed International, a Singapore-based cloud computing company, according to Bloomberg News. China hawks have used these reports as more reason to clamp down on AI chip sales to China.

Sixty-four percent of American voters want to pause sales of advanced AI chips to China while policymakers conduct an investigation into those sales to China, while 15% believe that a halt to these sales would cost a U.S. company billions of dollars before proving any wrongdoing was committed and 22% are not sure what should be done, per the Demand Progress poll.

Demand Progress Education Fund commissioned the survey, conducted by YouGov Blue, polling 1,000 voters from November 13 to 17 and the poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 3.7%.

CHONGQING, CHINA - JULY 17: In this photo illustration, the logo of Nvidia Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) is displayed on a smartphone screen, with the reflection of the Chinese national flag from a computer screen visible on the device, placed on a red-lit keyboard, on July 17, 2025 in Chongqing, China.

An Nvidia spokesperson pointed to Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress’s announcement that the company is no longer shipping advanced H200 Nvidia chips to China despite the federal government’s blessing to do so, according to Bloomberg News. (RELATED: Nvidia Walks Away From $2.4 Billion In China Sales Days After CEO’s Spy Scandal)

The Department of Commerce approved almost 900,000 AI chips to China to Pentagon-designated Chinese Military Companies such as Alibaba and Tencent, according to House Foreign Affairs Committee Brian Mast, per his committee’s press release. The House Foreign Affairs Committee said its findings include requests by Nvidia to rely on possible chip-trafficking fronts to enable AI chips to Chinese companies, per the press release. This House report amounts to the most detailed public disclosure of Chinese chip licenses through the Export Control Reform Act of 2018, per the press release, as Congress considers more chip export controls through a must-pass defense bill, the DCNF reported.

China has repeatedly found ways to skirt around America’s export controls, which includes the sale of advanced AI chips to dozens of Chinese companies, many of whose offices were found to be empty and have connections to firms sanctioned for national security risks, the New York Times reported.

Nearly two-thirds of those polled said Nvidia has a financial interest in pacing the AI race between China and the United States as fast as possible, while 9% say Nvidia is merely meeting demand and a little more than a quarter say they are not sure.

Roughly three-quarters of voters believe the federal government should conduct an investigation into whether advanced AI chips reached China, 12% believe Nvidia should lead its own probe first and 15% are not sure.

Seventy percent of voters said the argument that selling advanced AI chips to China could aid China’s military was either very or somewhat convincing.

Americans want AI guardrails and believe some companies have a “near-monopoly” on chip production, the survey found.

At least 42% of voters said their opinions about AI, data centers built in their communities and big technology companies affected how they voted in 2026. Although opinion is split on partisan lines, Democrats were much more motivated to vote based on these issues compared to Republicans or Independents.

Seventy-two percent of those polled said the government should set AI safety rules, while only 11% said companies should decide when their AI models are safe to release, per the survey commissioned by Demand Progress Education Fund.

This mirrors other polling which found that 66% of Democrats said AI and data centers were a crucial factor deciding their vote and 33% said it was a crucial factor deciding their vote, according to CNN exit polling. Voters across 21 swing districts want lawmakers to champion “common-sense” AI safety measures, according to a Guidant Polling and Strategy survey obtained by the DCNF.

More than 84% of voters back regulations back government safety measures, rules for monitoring AI behavior, rules to stop rogue AI hacking, giving the government the power to shut down AI-related threats and setting up third-party evaluators for AI safety, according to the Guidant survey.

Tuesday’s election was a mandate to challenge out-of-control corporate power, and that includes AI companies. Today, Demand Progress and a coalition of 50+ groups asked @SenSchumer & @RepJeffries to appoint members who support strong AI guardrails to key congressional committees https://t.co/ai07UuuHO8

Top House lawmakers like Congressional Progressive Caucus Chair Greg Casar plan to make AI oversight and legislation a “top priority,” according to Punchbowl News. Democrats flipped nine Senate seats, the most in nearly 70 years, per PBS, and House Democrats will have the largest majority since the early 1990s, according to NPR.

Almost two-thirds of those surveyed found that one company, Nvidia, controls too much of the chip market used to power AI, while 14% believe the company’s dominance keeps America ahead of China, and 22% said they were not sure. Nvidia controls roughly three-quarters of the AI chip market, per Yahoo Finance.

بر اساس یک نظرسنجی که به طور انحصاری توسط بنیاد Daily Caller News به دست آمده است، آمریکایی‌ها می‌خواهند فروش تراشه‌های هوش مصنوعی (AI) به چین را متوقف کنند. یک نظرسنجی به سفارش صندوق آموزش پیشرفت تقاضا نشان داد بسیاری از آمریکایی‌ها در انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای بر اساس بدبینی‌شان نسبت به هوش مصنوعی، مراکز داده و شرکت‌های بزرگ فناوری رأی دادند. اکنون، آنها می‌خواهند هوش مصنوعی را مهار کنند و معتقدند که برخی از شرکت‌ها قدرت بیش از حدی دارند، که ممکن است کشور را در معرض خطر قرار دهد. «این نظرسنجی جدید ثابت می‌کند که هوش مصنوعی یک موضوع جناحی نیست. هیچ‌کس نمی‌خواهد شرکت‌ها سود شرکت‌ها را بالاتر از ایمنی قرار دهند و هیچ‌کس به آنها اعتماد نمی‌کند تا جنایات خود را بررسی کنند. کالین مک‌گلین، مشاور هوش مصنوعی در توسعه تقاضا، در بیانیه‌ای به DCNF گفت: کنگره باید Nvidia را به دلیل نقشش در قاچاق تراشه بررسی کند و مشخص کند که آیا به امنیت ملی ما آسیب وارد شده است یا خیر. به گزارش بلومبرگ، شرکت محاسبات ابری مستقر در سنگاپور. شاهین‌های چین از این گزارش‌ها به‌عنوان دلیل بیشتری برای محدود کردن فروش تراشه‌های هوش مصنوعی به چین استفاده کرده‌اند. شصت و چهار درصد از رای‌دهندگان آمریکایی می‌خواهند فروش تراشه‌های هوش مصنوعی پیشرفته به چین را متوقف کنند، در حالی که سیاست‌گذاران در مورد این فروش‌ها به چین تحقیق می‌کنند، در حالی که 15 درصد معتقدند توقف این فروش‌ها میلیاردها دلار هزینه یک شرکت آمریکایی را به همراه خواهد داشت.

news.originalContent:
Australia beat England by three wickets with only one ball to spare as Nikhil Chaudhary’s 66 leads the charge in Melbourne.

Nikhil Chaudhary blasted 66 and a late cameo from Jack Edwards helped Australia edge past England by three wickets with a ball to spare in the opening T20 International of the series.

Chaudhary’s 38-ball knock was crucial, but it was Edwards’ late flurry that got the job done, with the fast-bowler hitting an unbeaten 25 off 11 as they chased down a victory target of 188 on Saturday.

It ensured they took a 1-0 lead in the five-match series and temporarily lifted some of the clouds hanging over Australian cricket. Four of the country’s previous five matches have resulted in defeats, including a 2-1 One-Day International home series defeat by England.

The win also came on the day that Cricket Australia backed Pat Cummins to stay on as Test captain, despite continued allegations that he and the rest of the 2018 team were aware of the use of sandpaper to tamper with the ball during their tour of South Africa.

England captain Harry Brook’s quickfire 65 had guided the visitors to 187-9 – the highest T20I score at the Melbourne Cricket Ground – but Australia’s response had already begun prior to the chase when their bowlers restricted the end of the tourists’ innings that had looked set to comfortably pass 200.

“Right, there is the future of the Australian cricket side with those young guys in it,” said Australia captain Mitchell Marsh.

“They’re a great bunch. Hopefully a win like that gives them a lot of confidence that they all belong.”

The run chase started badly for Australia with opener Jake Fraser-McGurk falling to just his third ball, undone by the spin of Liam Dawson.

Australia got going when debutant Sam Harper came in and took 20 off Jamie Overton’s first over.

But the 29-year-old swung the bat once too often and departed for 32 off 15 balls, earning new England fast-bowler Henry Crocombe a first T20 wicket.

They were 86-2 at the halfway mark, and when Dawson took a stunning catch to remove Marsh for 37, Australia’s hopes appeared to rest with Tim David.

But the big-hitter struggled to get going and was out for 20, leaving Chaudhary, in only his fourth T20 for Australia, in charge.

He departed chasing another boundary, only for Edwards to step up.

They needed 11 of the last over from Sam Curran, and when Edwards smacked a six off the first delivery, they were on their way to the win.

“Very entertaining to go down to the last couple of balls,” said Brook. “We were probably 10 runs short of what we needed on that surface.”

Earlier, England lost opener Phil Salt to the first ball and they were 13-2 in the third over after Aneurin Donald was also removed cheaply for 10.

But Brook went to town, smacking three straight sixes from paceman Riley Meredith.

He reached 50 off 20 deliveries before his fiery knock ended when he got a faint outside edge off Chaudhary to wicketkeeper Harper.

Tom Banton was put down on 11, among six dropped catches by Australia, but his luck ran out on 39 when another debutant, Lachlan Shaw, held on to a difficult chance.

The wickets kept tumbling with Curran caught out on 21 and Will Jacks out lbw for three, with Jordan Cox hitting 27 to keep the scoreboard moving.
news.content: استرالیا با سه ویکت انگلیس را تنها با یک توپ خالی شکست داد زیرا نیکیل چوداری 66 در ملبورن پیشتاز بود. نیکیل چوداری 66 ضربه را شکست داد و یک ضربه کوتاه از جک ادواردز به استرالیا کمک کرد تا با سه ویکت انگلیس را با یک توپ در افتتاحیه T20 International سری بزند. ضربه 38 توپی چوداری بسیار مهم بود، اما این تلنگر دیرهنگام ادواردز بود که کار را به پایان رساند، با 25 گل 11 شکست ناپذیر در حالی که آنها هدف پیروزی 188 را در روز شنبه تعقیب کردند. این اطمینان حاصل شد که آنها در سری بازی های ابری 5-مسابقه استرالیا با برتری 1-0 پیش افتادند. چهار مسابقه از پنج مسابقه قبلی این کشور منجر به شکست شده است، از جمله شکست 2-1 یک روزه بین المللی خانگی از انگلیس. این برد همچنین در روزی به دست آمد که کریکت استرالیا از پت کامینز برای ماندن به عنوان سردار آزمون حمایت کرد، علیرغم ادعاهای مداوم مبنی بر اینکه او و بقیه تیم 2018 از استفاده از کاغذ سنباده برای دستکاری توپ در آفریقای جنوبی مطلع بودند. شلیک سریع 65 هری بروک، کاپیتان انگلیس، بازدیدکنندگان را به 187-9 هدایت کرد - بالاترین امتیاز T20I در زمین کریکت ملبورن - اما واکنش استرالیا از قبل از تعقیب و گریز آغاز شده بود، زمانی که توپ گیران آنها پایان مسابقات توریست ها را محدود کردند که به نظر می رسید به راحتی از 200 عبور می کند. کاپیتان استرالیا میچل مارش گفت

news.originalContent:
Mathematicians say the claimed proof, made with Claude, could be historic, but it may take weeks to understand it.

A mathematician from the tech giant Anthropic claims to have proven one of the world’s most famous – and most elusive – maths problems with the help of AI.

Levent Alpoge wrote on his website on Friday: “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.”

If his claim holds up, the proof he says he has would settle a question that has defeated mathematicians for 167 years. Independent experts are now trying to verify it, but so far no human has read through the entire argument.

First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics.

Prime numbers are whole numbers which can be divided only by one and themselves, such as 2, 3, 5 and 7. They appear to be scattered along the number line with no obvious pattern but the Riemann hypothesis proposes that their overall distribution actually follows a deep, hidden order – just one that humans have yet to identify.

“The Riemann hypothesis is the most famous and important unsolved problem in mathematics,” Abhishek Saha, professor of mathematics at Queen Mary University of London, told Al Jazeera.

“The patterns of the primes are encoded in a mathematical object called the Riemann zeta function, introduced by Bernhard Riemann in 1859.”

It is one of the seven Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize Problems, each carrying a $1m award.

Alpoge, a member of the company’s technical staff, made the announcement on Friday in a four-page explanation posted on his website. He said the proof he has found covers the generalised Riemann hypothesis, which extends the original conjecture to a broader family of mathematical functions.

He did not publish a conventional paper. Alpoge released the argument in Lean, a programming language and proof assistant that checks reasoning step by step. He was open about how much of the work was Claude’s, writing that “Claude far outpaced me near the finish line”.

Kevin Buzzard, professor of pure mathematics at Imperial College London, said nobody yet understands what the proof actually shows.

“At the minute, we don’t even know why the theorem is true,” he told Al Jazeera. “It’s 17 million lines of Lean code, and this might correspond to tens of thousands of pages of mathematics. We don’t even yet know how much of this mathematics is new ideas, how much of it is just sort of standard stuff the machine just had to develop.

“At the minute, the proof is just millions of lines of gobbledygook written in a strange programming language,” he said. “And right now, as we speak, there’s people all over the world who are translating parts of this programming language back into English.”

He expects answers to come fairly soon, however. “Experience shows you that you give the humans the Lean code, and within a week or two, they have a much better understanding of what’s actually going on in this code,” he said.

“The implications of this hypothesis extend across large parts of mathematics, and hundreds of other mathematical results have been proved assuming this hypothesis is true,” Saha said. “A proof would settle a question that has occupied some of the greatest mathematical minds for over 160 years.”

Buzzard said the result also matters beyond pure mathematics, including for internet security.

“We know there are some algorithms that we run where they’re very quick, but we don’t actually know for sure if they work,” he said. “They seem to work, and we know that if the generalised Riemann hypothesis is true, then they do work.”

He said cryptographers had long worked on the assumption that the Riemann hypothesis is true. “In practice, people do tend to assume that the Riemann hypothesis is true because it’s a viable hypothesis to assume, because there’s so much evidence that it’s true,” he said. “But we can sleep slightly safer in our beds at night because it is true.”

Buzzard said the result stands out among recent AI breakthroughs in mathematics. He compared it with the Navier-Stokes problem, another Millennium Prize problem, which OpenAI said an unreleased AI model had solved in September. “That one doesn’t really have any applications at all,” he said, calling it “just of theoretical interest”. “Whereas the Riemann hypothesis has applications to neighbouring fields.

“It’s a very hard problem, but it’s definitely not the hardest problem in mathematics,” he said, pointing to even stronger versions such as the “extended Riemann hypothesis and the grand Riemann hypothesis”.

“The Riemann hypothesis is just, in some sense, at the foot of a mountain,” he said. “We’re beginning our trek up the mountain with this theorem.”

“The problem is relatively simple to state, but extraordinarily difficult to prove,” Saha said. “Mathematicians have developed vast amounts of sophisticated theory in their attempts to solve it, but none of the techniques developed over the past 167 years has been sufficient. The direct methods have all been tried, and none of them come close to resolving it.

“Until very recently, most mathematicians, myself included, believed that a proof would require substantial new mathematical theories, perhaps developed over the next few decades.”

He said the claimed proof had overturned his expectations. “My own intuition was that we were still several years away from a proof of the Riemann hypothesis. This claimed proof, if correct, shatters my model of reality,” he said.

“If difficult problems are like valuable mineral reserves buried miles underground, you first need to build the infrastructure to reach them. What this proof seems to have done is something completely different. It takes an incredibly complicated tour through the infrastructure built to reach a hundred other mineral reserves, situated far from the original destination, and somehow creates a wormhole to that destination.”

Buzzard said it is still too early to know what humans had been missing. “There is a chance that there were no ideas that the humans were missing. There is a chance that all of the ingredients were there, that nobody had just been smart enough to put everything together,” he said. “There is a chance that there’s a thousand pages of new ideas, very deep new theories.”

“Right now, we honestly can’t tell you, because nobody understands the proof of it. That will change. In a matter of weeks, that will change.”

The past year has been one of AI-driven advances in mathematics. An earlier AI-assisted result showed that at least 67.25 percent of a particular set of mathematical values follow the pattern predicted by the Riemann hypothesis. The new claim, if correct, would extend this to all of them.

“AI is creating a revolution in mathematics,” Saha said. “It is helping us solve problems previously thought out of reach and, in doing so, it will undoubtedly lead to the creation of new mathematics. However, this also means that the way mathematicians have traditionally conducted research will no longer be how it is done in the future.

“Asking the right questions, creating new research directions, writing good expositions, and acting as an effective director or conductor for AI will become increasingly important, while technical brilliance in constructing proofs may become less so.”

He argued that the credit should go to Alpoge. “Much of the press is referring to this as a proof by Claude. I think they should instead credit the person involved: Levent Alpoge,” he said. “Others with similar access to frontier AI models and computing resources were not able to come up with a proof of the Riemann hypothesis.

“This proof shows that a brilliant mathematician can direct and orchestrate AI in ways that allow them to prove theorems others cannot. The honour of proving RH, if the proof holds up, belongs largely to him. He should get a Fields Medal for this.” The Fields Medal is a prestigious mathematics prize awarded every four years by the International Congress of Mathematicians (ICM) to mathematicians under age 40.

Buzzard rejected fears that AI has made human mathematicians redundant. “The rumours that maths is dead have been greatly exaggerated,” he said. “What’s actually happening is that mathematics has a very exciting and powerful brand new tool.”

“Mathematics is infinitely big. You can’t solve all of it,” he said. He compared AI with the telescope. “Historically, astronomers were just staring at the sky, right? And then the telescope was invented, and all of a sudden we can see everything much, much more clearly.

“The AI doesn’t have taste, not yet anyway. You tell it what to do, and it does it,” he said. “We’ve basically got our own telescope.”

Buzzard said AI was “beginning to democratise” mathematics, although for now the breakthroughs are concentrated in a few firms. “Currently, it is the tech companies with access to the new internal models who are doing the best breakthroughs right now, but this will change as more powerful models become available to the public and the tech companies lose interest.”

He said some of the unease among mathematicians is about loss. “They are grieving because the field is changing rapidly, and with change comes loss. We will do mathematics in new ways going forward, and some people will miss the old ways,” he said.

“The other reason people are upset is that it has hurt a lot of people’s egos. Humans were the best at mathematics, and the best humans would prove theorems, and the theorems would be named after them.”

ریاضیدانان می گویند که اثبات ادعا شده، ساخته شده با کلود، می تواند تاریخی باشد، اما ممکن است هفته ها طول بکشد تا آن را بفهمیم. ریاضیدانی از غول فناوری Anthropic ادعا می کند که یکی از معروف ترین – و گریزناپذیر ترین – مسائل ریاضی جهان را با کمک هوش مصنوعی ثابت کرده است. اگر ادعای او ثابت شود، شواهدی که او می‌گوید دارد می‌تواند مشکلی را حل کند که ۱۶۷ سال ریاضیدانان را شکست داده است. کارشناسان مستقل اکنون در تلاش برای تأیید آن هستند، اما تاکنون هیچ انسانی کل استدلال را نخوانده است. اولین بار توسط برنهارد ریمان، ریاضیدان آلمانی در سال 1859 پیشنهاد شد، این فرضیه مربوط به توزیع اعداد اول است و به طور گسترده به عنوان مهم ترین سؤال باز در ریاضیات محض در نظر گرفته می شود. اعداد اول اعداد کاملی هستند که فقط بر یک و خودشان تقسیم می شوند، مانند 2، 3، 5 و 7. به نظر می رسد که آنها در امتداد خط اعداد بدون الگوی واضحی پراکنده هستند، اما فرضیه ریمان پیشنهاد می کند که توزیع کلی آنها در واقع از یک نظم عمیق و پنهان پیروی می کند - فقط نظمی که انسان ها هنوز باید آن را شناسایی کنند. آبیشک ساها، استاد ریاضیات در دانشگاه کوئین مری لندن، به الجزیره گفت: «فرضیه ریمان مشهورترین و مهم‌ترین مسئله حل‌نشده در ریاضیات است. الگوهای اعداد اول در یک شی ریاضی به نام تابع زتای ریمان، که توسط برنهارد ریمان در سال 2014 معرفی شد، کدگذاری می‌شوند.»

news.originalContent:
Two drones attack a cargo ship that Finnish authorities say has links to Russia’s armed forces.

Rescue efforts are under way in the Gulf of Finland after a Russian cargo ship was hit by drones close to Russia’s maritime border.

The ship, the Sparta II, is on fire and has now drifted into Finnish territorial waters, authorities say.

Finland’s Ministry of Defence said its forces had detected a drone attack on a Russian vessel in international waters, with the vessel sustaining damage, and dispatched Finnish Border Guard units to the scene.

A photograph taken by a Border Guard patrol plane shows flames and thick smoke coming from the rear of the ship.

The attack happened west of Gogland Island on Saturday morning, with Finland temporarily instating air and sea traffic restrictions in the eastern part of the gulf.

Finland’s Border Guard said the vessel is known to have links to the Russian armed forces.

According to the Border Guard, the crew of the Sparta II have not been forced to abandon ship, and there has been no environmental damage so far from the drone attack, while the vessel is in the open sea off the southern coastal town of Loviisa.

“The Border Guard is preparing to evacuate people and assist in firefighting operations,” Finnish authorities said.

It is not clear who was behind the attack, but Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo wrote on X that “war is spilling over into our immediate vicinity. The Finnish authorities are handling the situation in the Gulf of Finland, where a drone strike has hit a Russian merchant vessel. Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor.”

Alexander Drozdenko, governor of Russia’s Leningrad region, said the damage had yet to be fully assessed.

“Three nautical miles from the Russian Federation’s border, a cargo vessel bound for Kaliningrad was attacked by two drones,” he wrote on the messaging app Max.

Kaliningrad’s Governor Alexey Besprozvannykh said supplies to the Russian exclave were not at risk.

The Gulf of Finland is a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea between Finland and Estonia, both NATO members. It connects Russia’s former capital of Saint Petersburg with its Kaliningrad enclave by sea.

Finland’s Ministry of Defence said air and sea traffic restrictions had been put in place as a precaution in case further drones needed to be intercepted, adding that Finland had notified its allies of the incident.

Ukraine and Russia have attacked each other’s shipping throughout the war, mostly in the Black Sea.

Earlier this month, Finland’s military said it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland, which Ukraine took credit for. Helsinki said it had raised concerns with Kyiv about striking in the area afterwards.
news.content: دو پهپاد به یک کشتی باری حمله کردند که مقامات فنلاند می گویند با نیروهای مسلح روسیه ارتباط دارد. به گفته مقامات، کشتی باری روسی در نزدیکی مرز دریایی روسیه مورد اصابت پهپادها قرار گرفت، تلاش های نجات در خلیج فنلاند در جریان است. وزارت دفاع فنلاند اعلام کرد که نیروهای این کشور حمله پهپادی به یک کشتی روسی را در آب‌های بین‌المللی شناسایی کرده‌اند که کشتی آسیب دیده است و واحدهای گارد مرزی فنلاند را به محل اعزام کرده‌اند. عکسی که توسط یک هواپیمای گشت مرزی گرفته شده است، شعله‌های آتش و دود غلیظی را نشان می‌دهد که از عقب کشتی می‌آید. این حمله صبح شنبه در غرب جزیره گوگلند رخ داد و فنلاند به طور موقت محدودیت‌های تردد هوایی و دریایی را در بخش شرقی خلیج اعمال کرد. گارد مرزی فنلاند گفت که این کشتی با نیروهای مسلح روسیه ارتباط دارد. به گفته گارد مرزی، خدمه اسپارتا 2 مجبور به ترک کشتی نشده اند و تاکنون هیچ آسیب زیست محیطی از حمله پهپاد وارد نشده است، در حالی که کشتی در دریای آزاد در نزدیکی شهر ساحلی جنوبی لوویسا است. مقامات فنلاند گفتند: "گارد مرزی در حال آماده شدن برای تخلیه مردم و کمک به عملیات اطفای حریق است." مشخص نیست چه کسی پشت این حمله بوده است، اما پتری اورپو، نخست وزیر فنلاند در X نوشت که "جنگ در حال سرایت به نزدیکی ما است. مقامات فنلاند در حال مدیریت اوضاع در خلیج فارس هستند.

news.originalContent:
Sudan’s displaced elderly often have to support grandchildren or fend for themselves.

Khartoum, Sudan – Hamad Mohammed Adam, 70, should be spending his days surrounded by his family and enjoying the comfort of life in his home village. Instead, he finds himself among hundreds of displaced elderly people in a camp in western Omdurman, with little between him and death.

Three months ago, Adam’s life changed when the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary attacked his village near Bara, northern Kordofan. He followed the rest of the village and fled, leaving behind his home, belongings and most painfully, his family.

“It was an early morning last August when the Rapid Support Forces militia invaded our village near Bara. It was a terrifying morning; they were killing everyone, women, men, children,” he said. “I ran with some friends and spent days to reach Omdurman. I am lucky that I have survived, but I am worried about my family.”

The war between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the RSF paramilitary, two former military allies now engaged in a bitter power struggle for Sudan since April 2023, has affected all parts of the country. When fighting erupts in one area, residents are often forced to flee to another, where they lack jobs, a home, or a support base.

After travelling for about 300km (186 miles), Adam found himself in western Omdurman, close to the capital Khartoum. Today, he resides at al-Moulih camp for displaced people in western Omdurman, home to approximately 10,000 people, with those aged over 65 accounting for about one in five residents.

His escape from the fighting between the SAF and RSF, which has triggered one of the world’s worst humanitarian crises, was only the start of his troubles. Adam knows nothing about the whereabouts of his family, and they don’t know where he is.

Lacking the support of his family, Adam’s immediate concern is finding enough food, medication and healthcare to survive. But the uncertainty of his family’s fate weighs heavily on him every day.

In the same camp, Aisha Alneel, 70, has lost more than her home: The security, independence and family connections that once shaped her life. She’s accompanied by her 72-year-old sister who needs medical attention, and her greatest hope is to reunite with her family and regain some sense of normality.

“I came to Port Sudan two years ago after losing my home in Khartoum. My plan is to travel with my older sister, but we faced financial strain,” she said. “We preferred to stay at this displacement camp in Port Sudan until we have enough money to leave.”

Sudan’s older population, classified as aged above 65 by the United Nations, is 1.8 million people in 2026, accounting for 3.5% of the population, according to the UN’s Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia.

Many elderly displaced people depend on regular medical supervision and assistance with everyday activities. When conflict forces them to abandon their homes, families, and familiar environments, these essential support systems can disappear overnight. It also disrupts or destroys the infrastructure and services they relied on to maintain a dignified life.

Traditionally, Sudanese families and local communities played a central role in caring for older relatives. Younger family members often assisted with food, medical appointments and daily needs, but the war has seen families scattered across Sudan and the country’s social fabric destroyed.

Living standards have plunged to levels last seen in the early 1990s, making it difficult for families to survive, let alone provide support to others. The UNDP has noted that Sudan’s economy has shrunk by more than 40 percent since the war broke out, and extreme poverty is expected to rise above 60 percent. This has placed additional pressure on institutions responsible for caring for older people.

At Al-Daw Hajooj home for the elderly, the management faces the difficult task of providing care to senior citizens amid a wider humanitarian crisis.

Moubarak Satti, director of Al-Daw Hajooj, told Al Jazeera that the home has 11 seniors and the situation remains “difficult” due to a lack of financial support needed to run the elderly care programmes.

“Like many institutions, we have been severely affected by the war. We lost our only vehicle, which we use it to transport elderly people to medical facilities; we lost many people during the conflict due to the lack of medical care,” Satti said.

“We welcome financial support from the community, NGOs, and international humanitarian organisations to continue providing care and essential services to older people.”

This requires more than emergency food assistance. It needs a coordinated response that recognises elderly people as a particular group with specific needs, said Satti.

The strain of displacement also impacts older people’s mental and emotional wellbeing. Separation from children and grandchildren, uncertainty about the future, and feelings of anxiety and helplessness can create intense feelings of isolation, government officials have said.

The Khartoum State Ministry of Social Development has provided support to vulnerable groups, such as the elderly, coordinating social protection services and working with relevant institutions to respond to the needs of displaced communities.

But the scale of the problem is staggering, with about 8.6 million people currently displaced. Attacks on civilian areas have also severely disrupted public services, making government and NGO support increasingly challenging, Minister of Social Welfare Siddig Ferini told Al Jazeera.

“We have reunited dozens of elderly displaced people with their families in many Sudanese states, while others are still searching for loved ones,” Ferini said. “We call on humanitarian organisations, donors, and philanthropists to support elderly people through social care and essential services, especially amid the ongoing war and economic crisis.”
news.content:
سالمندان آواره سودانی اغلب مجبورند از نوه ها حمایت کنند یا از زندگی خود مراقبت کنند. خارطوم، سودان - حمد محمد آدم، 70 ساله، باید روزهای خود را در محاصره خانواده خود بگذراند و از آسایش زندگی در روستای خود لذت ببرد. در عوض، او خود را در میان صدها نفر از افراد مسن آواره در اردوگاهی در غرب اومدورمان می بیند که بین او و مرگ کمی وجود دارد. سه ماه پیش، با حمله شبه نظامی نیروهای پشتیبانی سریع (RSF) به روستای او در نزدیکی بارا در شمال کردوفان، زندگی آدام تغییر کرد. او بقیه روستا را دنبال کرد و فرار کرد و خانه، وسایل و از همه دردناک‌تر خانواده‌اش را رها کرد. او گفت: «صبح زود در اوت گذشته بود که شبه‌نظامیان نیروهای پشتیبانی سریع به روستای ما در نزدیکی بارا حمله کردند. صبح وحشتناکی بود؛ آنها همه را می‌کشتند، زن، مرد، کودک. من با چند نفر از دوستانم دویدم و روزها را گذراندم تا به عمران برسم. من خوش شانس هستم که زنده مانده ام، اما نگران خانواده ام هستم.
جنگ بین نیروهای مسلح سودان (SAF) و شبه نظامی RSF، دو متحد نظامی سابق که اکنون درگیر جنگ قدرت برای سودان از آوریل 2023 هستند، همه بخش های این کشور را تحت تاثیر قرار داده است. هنگامی که درگیری در یک منطقه شروع می شود، ساکنان اغلب مجبور می شوند به منطقه دیگر فرار کنند، جایی که فاقد شغل، خانه یا پایگاه پشتیبانی هستند. پس از سفر برای حدود 300 کیلومتر (186 مایل)، آدام خود را در غرب اومدورمان، نزدیک به پایتخت خارطوم یافت. امروز، او در اردوگاه آوارگان المولیح در غرب عمرمان، محل اقامت تقریبی ساکن است.

محل گیر کردن کلاه و ویژگی‌های کالبدشناختی این حیوان ۱۰۸۸ کیلوگرمی، خارج کردن کلاه را ناممکن کرد و او در نهایت روز پنجشنبه مرد.

فیونا حدود دو هفته پیش تصادفی کلاهی را بلعید که در محوطه زیستگاهش افتاده بود.

دوستداران حیوانات امیدوار بودند فیونا درمان شود. تولد نارس او  در سال ۲۰۱۷، در شبکه‌های اجتماعی معروفش کرده بود.

دکتر مایک ونینگر، مدیر بخش سلامت حیوانات در باغ‌وحش سینسیناتی، در بیانیه‌اش گفت که آندوسکوپی برای رسیدن به کلاه بی‌نتیجه بود.

دکتر ونینگر گفت: «محل کلاه و آناتومی بدن حیوان، خارج کردن آن با لاپاراسکوپی را غیرممکن کرد. هیچ درمانی  جز مراقبت‌ حمایتی، شانس موفقیت نداشت. کالبدشکافی هم تایید کرد که حتی با مراقبت‌های حمایتی هم نتیجه‌ای حاصل نمی‌شد.»

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

میشل کرلی، سخنگوی باغ‌وحش، گفته است که این کلاه پشمی اتفاقی وارد زیستگاه فیونا شده بود. به گفته او یکی از بازدیدکننده‌ها آن را به هوا پرتاب کرد و کلاه به پره‌های یک پنکه سقفی گیر کرد و از پنجره‌ای کوچک به محوطه زندگی او پرتاب شد.

فیونا در ابتدا هیچ علائمی نداشت اما چند روز بعد اشتهایش کم شد.

کارکنان باغ‌وحش تلاش کردند با تحریک او به غذا خوردن، به حرکت کلاه در طول دستگاه گوارش کمک کنند اما این تلاش‌ها بی‌نتیجه ماند.

کریستینا گورسوچ، مدیر بخش مراقبت از حیوانات در این باغ‌وحش، روز جمعه اعلام کرد که سایر اسب‌های آبی این باغ‌وحش پس از درگذشت فیونا، همچنان به روال عادی غذا می‌خورند و رفتار می‌کنند.

خانم گورسوچ گفت: «دشوار است که بدانیم دقیقا چه احساسی دارند اما به نظر می‌رسد رفتارشان کاملا عادی است.»

دیو جنیک، مدیر باغ‌وحش سینسیناتی هم گفت «ما شاهد ابراز محبت فراوان مردم این شهر و جاهای دیگر بودیم» و «دیشب وقتی دیدیم که ورزشگاه‌ها، پل‌ها و ساختمان‌ها به افتخار فیونا با نور بنفش روشن شده‌اند، بسیار تحت تأثیر قرار گرفتیم.»

حتی مجلس سنای ایالات متحده هم روز جمعه قطعنامه‌ای را برای گرامی‌داشت یاد این اسب آبی محبوب تصویب کرد.

فیونا زمانی به شهرت رسید که در سال ۲۰۱۷ در باغ‌وحش سینسیناتی نارس متولد شد و برای زنده ماندن با دشواری‌های بسیاری روبه‌رو بود. وزن او هنگام تولد ۱۳ کیلوگرم بود که به گفته مسئولان باغ‌وحش، تقریبا نصف کمترین وزن ثبت‌شده برای نوزادان این گونه جانوری تا آن زمان محسوب می‌شد.

آقای جنیک گفت: «حمایتی که از سراسر جهان احساس می‌کنیم، مرا به یاد زمانی می‌اندازد که همه دست به دست هم دادند تا برای زنده ماندن او دعا کنند و امیدوار باشند. او زنده ماند و نزدیک به یک دهه، لبخند به لبان ما آورد.»

news.originalContent:
رسانه‌های آمریکا می‌گویند اف‌بی‌آی (پلیس فدرال) و وزارت کشاورزی هدف حملات سایبری قرار گرفته‌اند.

شبکه‌های خبری ان‌بی‌سی و سی‌ان‌ان اولین رسانه‌هایی بودند که این دو حمله را گزارش کردند.

هنوز مشخص نیست که آیا این حملات ارتباط داشته‌اند یا کار چه گروه یا افرادی بوده‌اند.

این در حالی است که نگرانی‌ از موج اخیر اختلالات فنی در نهادهای مهم ایالات متحده افزایش یافته است.

در هفته‌های اخیر، اختلالات گسترده در سامانه‌های مختلف از جمله حمل‌ونقل و ارتباطات و تجارت الکترونیک برای شمار زیادی از کاربران در سراسر آمریکا مشکل ایجاد کرده است.

بر اساس گزارش‌ها حتی یک شبکه فوق‌محرمانه در آژانس امنیت ملی آمریکا هم تحت تأثیر این اختلالات قرار گرفته است.

هم‌زمان، سامانه‌های پرداخت‌ به کشاورزان در وزارت کشاورزی آمریکا نیز هدف حمله سایبری قرار گرفته‌اند. این وزارتخانه نگران است که بخش‌های دیگری از شبکه‌اش هم تحت تاثیر قرار گرفته باشد.

در یک ماه گذشته، سامانه‌های حمل‌ونقل هوایی، بانکی و امنیت ملی آمریکا هدف حملات سایبری بوده‌اند؛ حملاتی با اختلالات گسترده‌ که به کناره‌گیری شان کرنکراس، مدیر ارشد امنیت سایبری کاخ سفید، منجر شد.

گمان می‌رود هکرها از هوش مصنوعی برای شناسایی نقاط ضعف سامانه‌ها استفاده می‌کنند که ممکن است برای انسان قابل تشخیص نباشند.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

دونالد ترامپ تلاش کرده نگرانی افکار عمومی را کاهش دهد و از مردم خواسته است «آرامش خود را حفظ کنند.»

مقام‌های آمریکایی هم گفته‌اند که اختلالات اخیر با فعالیت‌های مجرمانه مرتبط نیست.

به گزارش ان‌بی‌سی، وزارت کشاورزی آمریکا دیروز به کارکنان خود اطلاع داد که سامانه‌ پرداخت یارانه به کشاورزان هدف حمله سایبری قرار گرفته است. این شبکه خبری به نقل از دو مقام پیشین این وزارتخانه گزارش داد که هکرها ممکن است از این سامانه پرداخت به‌عنوان یک میانبر برای دسترسی به اطلاعات حساس‌تر استفاده کنند.

یکی از مقام‌های پیشین وزارت کشاورزی آمریکا به ان‌بی‌سی گفت: «این وزارتخانه با مجموعه‌ای از مسائل زیستی نگران‌کننده سروکار دارد و اگر یک طرف متخاصم یا رقیب به همان اطلاعات دسترسی پیدا کند، ممکن است از تحقیقات خودمان علیه خودمان استفاده کند.»

سی‌ان‌ان هم دیروز  گزارش داد که اف‌بی‌آی برای دومین بار از ماه سپتامبر هدف حمله سایبری قرار گرفته است.

بر اساس این گزارش که به نقل از دو فرد مطلع از روند تحقیقات منتشر شده، این نهاد فدرال در حال بررسی احتمال نفوذ هکرها به مرکز ملی اطلاعات جنایی است.

این مرکز دارای یک پایگاه داده اطلاعات جنایی است که نهادهای انتظامی فدرال، ایالتی و محلی را به یکدیگر متصل می‌کند. از این پایگاه برای تبادل اطلاعات درباره احکام بازداشت و بررسی سوابق افراد استفاده می‌شود.

یکی از مقام‌های پیشین اف‌بی‌آی به سی‌ان‌ان گفت: «ماموران پلیس در سراسر کشور هر روز به این سامانه متکی هستند، برای شناسایی مجرمان تحت تعقیب، بررسی احکام بازداشت تعلیقی و دسترسی به اطلاعاتی که می‌تواند مستقیما بر امنیت ماموران و عموم مردم تأثیر بگذارد.»

این مقام پیشین همچنین ابراز نگرانی کرده است که هکرها ممکن است «دقت و صحت اطلاعاتی را که ماموران پلیس به آن اتکا می‌کنند، به خطر بیندازند».

این نفوذهای سایبری تازه کشف‌شده به اف‌بی‌آی و وزارت کشاورزی، حمله هکری توصیف شده‌اند و با اختلالات فنی اخیر، از جمله مشکلات سامانه ایمیل مایکروسافت موسوم به اوت‌لوک و اداره هوانوردی فدرال آمریکا، تفاوت دارند.

در ماه سپتامبر هم  یک گروه هکری با نام «شاینی‌هانترز» اطلاعات شخصی و حساس کارکنان را از طریق وبسایت استخدام اف‌بی‌آی هدف قرار داده بود.
